title: Swing Revival
style: A lively swing number bursts in with a bold brass section and playful saxophone riffs over a walking upright bass. Syncopated drums drive the rhythm, inviting dancing. Cheerful horn stabs and energetic call-and-response jams keep the mood loose and celebratory throughout., electronic, synth, aggressive
lyrics:
[Intro – smoky club ambience, glasses clinking]
Ladies and gentlemen...
Please keep dancing.
The band will continue playing...
even if the bandleader has completely lost his mind.
[Verse 1]
Brain tick-tick like a metronome crack
Thoughts all marching but they never march back
Shoes on the floor and the floor starts to spin
Band keeps playing while the noise creeps in
Snap goes the snare and the room bends wide
Trumpets laughing on the other side
Smile real big while the ceiling falls
Everybody swing while the sanity crawls
[Pre-Chorus]
Clap your hands if the walls are melting
Spin around if the clock ain't telling
Laugh it off like it's all just fine
Welcome to the breakdown line
[Chorus]
Swing! Swing! swing down the spiral
Jazz band playing while the brain goes viral
Dance! Dance! laugh through denial
Madness got a rhythm and it's strangely vital
Alright everyone — let's do the spiral!
Spin that mind like a broken vinyl
Trumpets screaming existential trial
Hey bartender pour one more smile
Everybody swing...
Down the spiral.
[Verse 2]
Tap shoes echo in a crooked hall
Mirrors whisper but they tell it wrong
Bassline walking but the steps all trip
Reality slipping from the record skip
Saxophone crying but it sounds so sweet
Mad parade marching through my heartbeat
Bandleader grinning with a shattered grin
“Keep on dancing while the void kicks in!”
[Pre-Chorus]
Clap your hands if the floor ain't stable
Kick your legs if the mind ain't able
Laugh it loud till the wires all fry
Swing while the sanity waves goodbye
[Chorus]
Swing! Swing! swing down the spiral
Jazz band playing while the brain goes viral
Dance! Dance! laugh through denial
Madness got a rhythm and it's strangely vital
Alright everyone — let's do the spiral!
Spin that mind like a broken vinyl
Trumpets screaming existential trial
Hey bartender pour one more smile
Everybody swing...
Down the spiral.
[Bridge – chaotic horns / bandleader call]
Round and round and round we glide
Thoughts doing the jitterbug inside
Band won't stop till the brain goes dark
Strike that match, let the madness spark
BANDLEADER
Alright everyone!
On the count of three!
ONE! TWO! THREE!
LET'S DO THE SPIRAL!
[Final Chorus – biggest band energy]
Swing! Swing! swing down the spiral
Jazz band playing while the brain goes viral
Dance! Dance! laugh through denial
Madness got a rhythm and it's strangely vital
Alright everyone — let's do the spiral!
Spin that mind like a broken vinyl
Trumpets screaming existential trial
Band keeps playing all the while...
Everybody swing...
...down the spiral.
